findings.evidence: Mathlib/FieldTheory/Finite/Basic.lean:333 defines `FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom K R` for arbitrary `[Field K] [Fintype K]`; the tensor proof only uses `coe_frobeniusAlgHom`, tensor powers, and the base-field power identity, while the bialgebra proof likewise uses only Frobenius naturality and that identity.
findings.fix: State both APIs over `(K : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype K]`, with exponent `Fintype.card K`; obtain the required prime-field case by instantiating `K := ZMod p`.
findings.issue: `tensorProductMap_frobeniusAlgHom_pow_apply`, and consequently `frobeniusBialgHom`/`frobeniusBialgHom_apply` at Bialgebra.lean:38, specialize the base to `ZMod p`, although their arguments use only finite-field Frobenius and its cardinality.

summary: The Frobenius tensor-product identity and bialgebra morphism are unnecessarily restricted to prime fields; the same proofs naturally apply over every finite field.
